test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct meaning of the idiom 'kick the bucket' as used in the sentence below:

He passed on all his belongings to his nephew before he kicked the bucket.
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 2) Died.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kick the bucket** is an idiom that means to die. (मृत्यु हो जाना)

 
 
• **Example:** He passed on all his belongings to his nephew before he kicked the bucket.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Died**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Went on vacation** (छुट्टी पर गए): This means to take a trip or holiday, which is not the intended meaning of the idiom "kick the bucket."
 
• **Bought a farm** (खेत खरीदा): This phrase is sometimes used euphemistically to mean "died" but is not the correct idiom for this context.
 
• **Got angry** (गुस्सा आना): This means to become upset or enraged, which is unrelated to the idiom "kick the bucket."
